gpu_tip: ~64GB total at 128K context. Qwen3.8's hybrid Gated DeltaNet design keeps only 16 of its 64 layers on a real KV cache, so context adds relatively little on top of the weights. Still, at BF16 this is the biggest build here — an 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus ~64GB of DDR5 system RAM covers it via llama.cpp's per-layer offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~64GB — even a 64GB MacBook Pro (M4 Max or M5 Max) leaves almost no headroom; a 128GB config is the realistic choice.
